newsitem.title: USA: Sprint launches gold dime hunt.
newsitem.headline: Sprint launches gold dime hunt.

text.p: Sprint Corp said Thursday it would drop 1,000 24-karat gold-plated dimes around the country as part of a promotional effort, with the first dime found worth $25,000 to the lucky finder.
The promotion was scheduled to start Thursday in New York City where a "mentalist," The Amazing Kreskin, would offer predictions as to where the dimes are located.

The first person to find a dime and call the Sprint 1-800 number will win $25,000 and one year of free long-distance service from Sprint. The next 10 dime hunters will get the free service and $1,000 each.
All the others will get pre-paid long-distance prizes, Sprint said.
